name: CISA (Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency)
operator: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), U.S. Department of Homeland Security
tier_rationale: U.S. government agency and national CERT (A8 trusted: government bodies, national CERTs/CSIRTs; CISA/NVD named among the trusted operators). Public catalogues, published terms (U.S. Government works).

reliability.justification: The KEV catalogue lists only vulnerabilities whose active exploitation CISA confirmed with reliable evidence; curated by the agency that issues the remediation directives (BOD 22-01).

kev.title: Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue (known_exploited_vulnerabilities.json, dataset; local lookups only)

terms.quote: Offline module vulnerability_cve/cisa_kev: known_exploited_vulnerabilities.json from www.cisa.gov registered with register_dataset (TTL 6 h; US public domain) and indexed locally by cveID; zero per-CVE requests (disclosure none, TLP:RED-safe).

kev.notes: Quote: binding council text (P182 cond 1); research C0429 terms 'US Government public data' / 'US public domain' (verified_live 200, 1.9 MB, ETag/Last-Modified honoured: conditional GET gives 304). A missing file under /sites/default/files/feeds/ answers an Akamai 'Access Denied' 403 page, never 404: the dataset manager keeps the previous copy. Used by cisa_kev (batch p1-G08-1). 'kev' stays CISA-only (P182 cond 4): other exploitation evidence goes to the attribute 'exploited'.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G08-1 (P182 cisa_kev). Other batches extend it (cisa__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers), e.g. P374 cisa_advisories (www.cisa.gov advisories feed). No quota block: the catalogue is one bulk download refreshed every 6 h through the dataset manager (conditional GET), never a per-CVE request.
